purpose: Independent cross-slice linkage audit after P13 Human Settlement Systems maturation and M2 material-linkage correction.

coverage.relation_contract: Each cross-slice Relation has explicit frame_ref, no Relation participant, and at least two participants.
coverage.corpus_scope: Current corpus through M2, including six newly justified M2 material cross-slice relations.

findings.basis: Six P13 settlement relations were added only where a direct conceptual or dependency linkage is substantive: settlement ↔ housing, infrastructure, transportation, water infrastructure, energy systems, and public health.
The added P13 and M2 relations use the existing cross-slice contract: explicit frame_ref, no Relation participant, and two claim participants. No duplicate relation was introduced.
The added relations expose bounded conceptual or dependency linkage without asserting unsupported causal direction and preserve the evidence epistemic boundary.

conclusion.next_step: M2 post-correction substantive audit is PASS; dedicated M2 CLEAN checkpoint and independent exact-head 3/3 verification remain.

epistemic_boundary: Relations, conformance and provenance do not establish truth and do not replace independent evidence.
